strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Closes the reopened semantic protocol/event contract blocker with a Runtime-owned generated contract, golden Rust-to-VSIX fixture tests, and guard-enforced drift detection so external controllers can depend on stable request/result semantics.
Keeps protocol semantics, unknown-field rejection, enum handling, and durable event migration coupling inside Runtime/protocol/store authority rather than CLI, VSIX, prose, or model output.
Preserves controlled JSON-RPC and MCP tool execution boundaries by making public Runtime params fail closed on unknown fields while leaving tool execution authority in Rust Runtime.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development, runtime_permission_enforcement, and controlled_workspace_tools by tightening the RRP-5.5 ledger payload classification inventory so TaskCompleted can no longer satisfy terminal evidence with unknown-only payload data.
answers.new_capability: TaskCompleted ledger events now require at least one known bounded terminal evidence field before append; generated semantic contract evidence and guard checks record known_field_required:true while full ledger payload typing remains release-blocking debt.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: RRP-5.5 rejected empty TaskCompleted payloads and malformed known fields, but a payload containing only unknown fields still passed despite the descriptor claiming bounded terminal evidence.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Brownie could append TaskCompleted ledger evidence that contains no recognized terminal signal, weakening durable replay and allowing the audit text to overstate typed-known-field validation.
answers.non_duplicative: This is the RRP-5.6 corrective for TaskCompleted known terminal evidence; it does not repeat RRP-5.5 per-event classification, RRP-5.4 schema/instance fingerprint splitting, RRP-7.1 deadline/durability work, or CI workflow hardening.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. RRP-5.6 adds no JSON-RPC method and only hardens ledger payload validation, generated contract evidence, and guards.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. The generated semantic contract and audits are release evidence, not a Runtime diagnostic endpoint, dashboard, or user-facing summary surface.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: RunLedger append now rejects TaskCompleted payload objects unless at least one recognized terminal evidence field is present, while still allowing additional fields and keeping TaskCompleted classified as typed_known_fields_open release-blocking debt.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Headless recovery and replay get stronger terminal ledger evidence because unknown-only TaskCompleted payloads fail closed before durable append.
answers.milestone_progress: Narrows protocol-event-canonization debt by closing the known TaskCompleted evidence mismatch while keeping Runtime Release Ready false until protocol-event-canonization, platform-deadline-durability-hardening, runtime-release-guard-ci, and owner license/publish/release decisions are resolved.

implementation_audit_classification.evidence: RRP-5.2 remains closed for all 51 explicit Runtime methods and all public *Params unknown-field policies.
RRP-5.3 remains closed for recursive schemars-derived method param/result schemas, nested $defs, schema refs, and recursive schema fingerprints.

implementation_audit_classification.surface: Ledger payload schema and instance fingerprint split
implementation_audit_classification.evidence: RRP-5.4 remains closed for fixed event-kind/version schema fingerprints, separate diagnostic instance-shape fingerprints, v2 envelope validation, and verified legacy v1 envelope compatibility.

RRP-5.5 records an explicit payload schema classification and release-blocking status for every LedgerEventKind and removes any{...} fallback descriptors from generated contract evidence; RRP-5.6 keeps that inventory and adds a guarded known terminal evidence requirement for TaskCompleted.
RRP-5.6 rejects empty or unknown-only TaskCompleted payload objects before append, validates known fields, and records known_field_required:true in generated payload schema descriptor evidence.

TaskCompleted is typed-known-fields-open and now requires at least one known bounded terminal evidence field while still allowing additional fields; all other current ledger payload families remain versioned_open release-blocking debt until strict typed, payload-absent, or legacy-only schemas are assigned.
The phase does not set runtime_release_ready=true, change license/publish/release metadata, start hosted platform work, or modify .github workflow files.

Review must confirm TaskCompleted requires at least one known bounded terminal evidence field, open classifications remain release-blocking, any{...} fallback descriptors are rejected, and Runtime Release Ready remains false.

exit_criteria: docs/architecture/runtime-semantic-protocol-contract.json is generated by brownie-protocol and covers every explicit Runtime method in the canonical map.
The generated artifact includes recursive type_schemas with $defs for nested structs/enums and every method records request/result schema refs plus recursive schema fingerprints.
The generated artifact records one event_payload_schema_classifications entry per LedgerEventKind with classification, contract status, and release_blocking_until_typed evidence.

guard:protocol-event-canonization fails when ledger payload classifications are missing, descriptor fallback returns to any{...}, or full ledger payload closure is claimed while open classifications remain.

TaskCompleted known-field payload validation rejects empty objects, unknown-only objects, and malformed known fields before append while remaining classified as typed_known_fields_open release-blocking debt.

protocol-event-canonization is reopened as partial required-before-release for full ledger payload typing while Runtime Release Ready remains false and platform-deadline-durability-hardening plus runtime-release-guard-ci remain open.

accepted_capability: Rust protocol crate owns and generates the full explicit Runtime semantic protocol contract artifact.
The semantic contract includes recursive JSON Schema for all method param/result types, including nested structs/enums through $defs.
Durable ledger payload schema fingerprints are separate from diagnostic instance-shape fingerprints.
Every LedgerEventKind has an explicit payload schema classification and release-blocking status in generated evidence.
Open ledger payload families cannot be treated as full typed payload schemas before release.
behavior_evidence: Rust semantic_contract tests cover generator freshness, canonical method-set equality, recursive nested schema refs, public-param unknown-field policy, and serde semantics.
brownie-store ledger_payload tests prove fixed schema versus instance fingerprint separation and reject empty, unknown-only, or malformed known TaskCompleted payload fields before append.

guard:protocol-event-canonization and its tests enforce RRP-5.5 classification inventory, RRP-5.6 TaskCompleted known-field evidence, and partial typed-ledger-payload evidence through the existing VSIX check path.
safety_boundary: Rust Runtime/protocol/store remain execution, admission, replay, permission, MCP, workspace mutation, durable state, protocol, and completion authority.
CLI and VSIX remain thin transport/projection clients and cannot grant Runtime authority.
Raw prompt, provider output, file content, absolute/canonical path, secret, environment value, executable content, and process output are not persisted as release evidence.
non_goals: Does not claim Runtime Release Ready.
Does not claim every LedgerEvent payload is strictly typed.
Does not change license, publish settings, tags, release assets, or public OSS release posture.
Does not add hosted scheduler, daemon, worker fleet, queue, generic shell, arbitrary process execution, remote Git expansion, signing infrastructure, or external platform products.
Does not modify .github workflow files; runtime-release-guard-ci remains a separate blocker.
Does not close platform-deadline-durability-hardening cross-platform or Runtime-wide deadline debt.
rejected_alternatives: Rejected docs-only closure because semantic compatibility needs generated fixtures and executable tests.
Rejected VSIX-owned schema generation because Runtime/protocol must own public wire semantics.
Rejected adding new RPCs because the closure concerns existing protocol compatibility.
technical_debt: protocol-event-canonization remains required-before-release for strict typed, payload-absent, or legacy-only schema assignments across every payload-bearing LedgerEventKind beyond this TaskCompleted known-field corrective.

platform-deadline-durability-hardening remains required-before-release for Runtime-wide persisted deadlines, non-Unix durability, cross-platform process-tree/stale-lock behavior, and the remaining MCP crash-window process-loss evidence called out by review.
runtime-release-guard-ci remains open Runtime-owned debt until workflow-scope credentials or owner-approved equivalent CI hardening exists.
Owner license/publish/release decisions remain required before OSS Release Ready.
next_capability_rationale: Return to runtime-release-guard-ci only when workflow-scope credentials or an owner-approved equivalent path is available; otherwise continue bounded audits while platform/deadline/cross-platform debt remains explicitly open.

runtime_release_dod: RRP-5.5 corrects protocol-event-canonization scope so RPC contracts and payload fingerprint split stay closed while full ledger payload typing remains required-before-release; RRP-5.6 closes the TaskCompleted known-terminal-evidence mismatch without claiming full ledger payload typing.
Runtime Release Ready remains false until remaining Runtime blockers and owner license/publish/release decisions are resolved.
runtime_boundary_contracts: No new RPC surface is added; existing Runtime JSON-RPC and ledger semantics are preserved and more strictly checked.
CLI and VSIX remain thin clients over Runtime-owned contracts.
external_control_plane_responsibilities: External scheduling, queueing, worker leases, hosted isolation, retry policy, metrics, alerts, SLA, tenant administration, billing, and secret-provider operations remain outside this local Runtime v0 phase.
external_adapter_responsibilities: Forge, pull request, review, notification, SIEM, OTel, language verifier, customer integration, and hosted MCP adapter responsibilities remain outside RRP-5.6.
commercial_solution_readiness: Packaging, distribution, signing, notarization, enterprise administration, operational runbooks, support, and commercial release decisions remain out of scope.
Cargo license and publish settings remain owner-decision items and are not changed by RRP-5.5.
